title.narrative: Core support to Transparency International Georgia 2022-2025

description.narrative: Core support to TI Georgia aims to reduce opportunities for corruption by promoting transparency, accountability, and integrity in public institutions.
Kärnstöd till TI Georgia syftar till att minska möjligheterna till korruption genom att främja öppenhet, ansvarsskyldighet och integritet i offentliga institutioner.

The overall objective of the intervention is defined as "to support building and empowering state institutions, develop good governance and the rule of law, ensure the transparency and direct accountability of the state institutions, support fair and democratic elections (for this aim including election observations) and protect universally recognized human rights".
For achieving overall objective the intervention plans through working towards few specific objectives:
Objective 1: Contribute to reduced opportunities for corruption (including high-level corruption) in the executive branch
Objective 2: Contribute to a more transparent, accountable and citizen-responsive local governance
Objective 3: Promote transparency, accountability, and integrity in Parliament and effectiveness of Parliament as an oversight institution and a branch of power counter-balancing the Executive
Objective 4: Promote more pluralistic political system through greater transparency and accountability in political parties and more competitive and fair elections
Objective 5: Promote independence, transparency, accountability, and integrity in the justice system
Objective 6: Promoting independence, professionalism and investigative activities of journalists to empower media as an anti-corruption watchdog
Objective 7: Raising awareness on matters of high public importance and consolidating efforts to support Georgias Euro-Atlantic integration
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
